entities.summary: Abolhassan Banisadr was an Iranian politician, writer, and political dissident who served as the first president of Iran from 1980 until his impeachment in 1981. Prior to his presidency, he was the Minister of Foreign Affairs in the Interim Government of Iran. He was the first president after the Iranian Revolution abolished the monarchy in 1979.
